agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report, the Board of Commissioners' Oversight Report, and the audited consolidated Financial Statements, granting full discharge of responsibility to the Boards.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the allocation of Rp351.4 billion in 2025 net profit, with Rp210.6 billion distributed as cash dividends and the remainder kept as retained earnings.
Agenda #3: The meeting approved the appointment of Paul Hadiwinata, Hidajat, Arsono, Retno, Palilingan & Rekan and Public Accountant Adi Santoso to audit the 2026 Financial Statements.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners was granted authority to determine the honorarium for the Boards and to define the duties and authorities of each Director.
Agenda #5: The meeting approved the reappointment of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners for the 2026-2029 term, led by President Director Oei Allan Wibisono and President Commissioner Yongky Wijaya.
Agenda #6: The Board of Directors was authorized to increase financing facilities and pledge company assets for expansion, subject to approval from the Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved a share buyback plan with a maximum budget of Rp200,000,000,000 and authorized the Board of Directors to execute or terminate the plan.
Agenda #8: The meeting approved amendments to Article 3 of the Articles of Association regarding the company's business objectives and authorized the Board of Directors to make necessary adjustments.
